# Awesome Tailwind UI Templates 1000 / Tailwind Atlas

A static collection of HTML UI demos. These are starting points, not finished applications or universally accessibility-certified components.

- Inventory: ./templates.json (generated from actual HTML files; unique IDs and paths)
- Browse: ./index.html
- No-JavaScript directory: ./catalog.html
- Inspector: ./preview.html?template=nav-001
- Maintenance: ./README.md
- Audit and unresolved review items: ./docs/AUDIT.md
- Contribution contract: ./docs/CONTRIBUTING.md
- License: ./LICENSE (does not relicense third-party images, fonts or brands)

Keep existing URLs. Do not invent template IDs from numeric ranges. Copy referenced assets with a template, compile Tailwind classes before publishing, and implement application-specific operations. Dictionaries en, zh-TW and zh-CN have partial coverage. Full-template boot checks are not a substitute for interaction, accessibility or visual review.
